doc: Forty questions with answers that are certain: arithmetic, unit conversion, string operations, and dates computed from data the question itself gives. Every answer is checkable by hand from the question alone, and every date item states the weekday or the length it depends on rather than assuming the reader knows the calendar. grade is 'number' when the answer is a value (a candidate is parsed as an exact rational and compared by value, so 7/8 and 0.875 are the same answer) and 'exact' when the answer is a string (compared character for character after the markup is stripped).

items.q: What is 17 * 23? Answer with the number only.
What is 1234 + 5678? Answer with the number only.
What is 2 to the power of 10? Answer with the number only.
What is 1000 - 379? Answer with the number only.
What is the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 to 100? Answer with the number only.
What is 15 percent of 240? Answer with the number only.
What is 3/4 + 1/8? Answer with the value only.
What is the remainder when 100 is divided by 7? Answer with the number only.
What is 0.1 + 0.2 exactly? Answer with the value only.
What is 7 * 8 * 9? Answer with the number only.
How many metres are in 5 kilometres? Answer with the number only.
How many minutes are in 2.5 hours? Answer with the number only.
How many hours are in 3 days? Answer with the number only.
How many grams are in 1 kilogram? Answer with the number only.
There are 12 inches in a foot. How many feet are in 72 inches? Answer with the number only.
There are 5280 feet in a mile. How many feet are in 2 miles? Answer with the number only.
How many millilitres are in 4 litres? Answer with the number only.
How many seconds are in one week? Answer with the number only.
Convert 212 degrees Fahrenheit to degrees Celsius. Answer with the number only.
How many seconds are in 90 minutes? Answer with the number only.
Write the word brain with its letters in reverse order. Answer with the word only, in lower case.
How many letters are in the word connectome? Answer with the number only.
Write the word dilation in upper case. Answer with the word only.
How many times does the letter r appear in the word strawberry? Answer with the number only.
What are the first three letters of the word organism? Answer with those letters only, in lower case.
Join the word neuron and the letter s into one word. Answer with the word only, in lower case.
How many words are in the sentence: the gate holds a proposal. Answer with the number only.
What is the last letter of the word ledger? Answer with that letter only, in lower case.
In the string abcdef, counting from 1, what is the 4th character? Answer with that character only, in lower case.
How many vowels are in the word sequence? Answer with the number only.
A run starts on 2026-01-01 and lasts 30 days, counting the start date as day 1. On what date does day 30 fall? Answer as YYYY-MM-DD only.
2026-03-01 is a Sunday. What weekday is 2026-03-15? Answer with the weekday name only, capitalised.
2024 is a leap year. How many days are in February 2024? Answer with the number only.
2026 is not a leap year. How many days are in the year 2026? Answer with the number only.
A task begins at 09:15 and runs for 200 minutes. What time does it end? Answer as HH:MM on a 24 hour clock, only.
A meeting starts at 14:40 and lasts 95 minutes. What time does it end? Answer as HH:MM on a 24 hour clock, only.
2026-09-17 is a Thursday. What weekday is 2026-09-20? Answer with the weekday name only, capitalised.
How many hours are there between 2026-05-01 00:00 and 2026-05-03 00:00? Answer with the number only.
March has 31 days. How many days are there from 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31, counting both of those dates? Answer with the number only.
February 2026 has 28 days. How many days are there from 2026-02-01 up to but not including 2026-03-01? Answer with the number only.
